notes.title: BUG fixes
notes.notes:
Added the function of scrolling through text with spaces, fixed the bug of duplicate text when scrolling through text on the keyboard

Fixed the issue of cg errors

Fixed issue with incorrect card bonus calculation

Added death mode

notes.title: bug fixes
notes.notes:
Bug fix fixed issues that may occur during option reading
Fixed issue with reading files in dreams
Modified the operation of the backpack and attribute buttons
Added display of remaining action points for the protagonist in one day
Added the function of triggering dialog boxes with the Enter key
Increased enemy health display during battles
Fixed a bug where the end of turn dealt health when carrying the Enrage skill
Fixed a bug where carrying certain critical strike items failed
Fixed a bug where using items would reduce jelly usage
Fixed a bug with incorrect skill display
